mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which reduces discount rates on equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test) during periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers a decline in consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5%, or the 5-day return is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their recent historical averages signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies exceeding thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%), lower interest rates reduce discount rates on equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or the regime is not an easing cycle (e.g., FEDFUNDS > 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 112.0 signals weakening supply-side growth, prompting investor concerns about economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO falling below 112.0, or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 136214.0) signal a robust labor market, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies meeting thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above its 6-month moving average signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of GDPC1 growth, or the trend is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.8 signals a supply-side shock, leading to investor pessimism and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO drops below 106.8 in the last month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO falling below 106.8, or the shock is not sustained.
